# Newo Platform Documentation

> Public guide to the Newo platform: voice, billing, security, agents and integrations.

## Pages

- [Overview](index.html): The Newo platform runs AI receptionists and customer-service agents that answer calls, texts and chats for appointment-driven businesses such as restaurant
- [Getting started](getting-started.html): Most businesses go from a new account to a live agent in under an hour: create the agent, check its setup, test it, then point your calls at it.
- [Voice and telephony](voice.html): Every voice call reaches a Newo agent through a carrier or web connection and is handled by Newo's Voice Service, which listens to the caller, runs the age
- [Billing](billing.html): Newo bills by usage, measured in units. Every conversation your agent handles uses units, and your plan sets how many units are included and how extra usag
- [Reliability, support and security](security.html): Newo watches agents in production around the clock, runs a 24/7 on-call rotation for incidents, and operates an ISO/IEC 27001 information security program.
- [Agents, integrations and partners](agents.html): Agents on the Newo platform are built from flows and skills, set up through Newo's builder tools or by chatting with Vibe Mode, and connected to booking, o
- [Frequently asked questions](faq.html): How long does it take to set up an agent? Most businesses create, test and launch an agent in under an hour using Agent Creator and the setup checklist.
